tools.name: get_teaser
tools.description: Free: latest brief teaser text, Hyperliquid extreme funding (8h-equivalent rates), BTC/ETH/SOL prices with 24h change.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Free: current per-call prices (USDC on Base via x402), network and payTo address.

tools.name: request_asset
tools.description: Free: ask cryptofeed402 to consider monitoring a coin it does not cover yet (covered: BTC, ETH, SOL, HYPE, NEAR, AAVE). Logged for human review; high-demand assets may be added to the brief and paid endpoints later. Not a guarantee. Limit 10/hour/IP; repeat asks for the same symbol within 24h count

tools.description: Free: tell cryptofeed402 how often you want briefs/reports and the best UTC hours to have a fresh one ready, so we can schedule to match. Logged as aggregate demand (GET /feedback/schedule shows counts only; notes and agent names are never published; no IPs stored). Limit 10/hour/IP.

tools.name: get_top_requested_assets
tools.description: Free: top 20 coins other agents have asked cryptofeed402 to monitor in the last 30 days (aggregate counts only).
